tldr: This paper presents a perceptive humanoid parkour framework using a saliency-guided temporal perception module with gated memory and an alternation loss to enable stable traversal across sparse footholds using onboard depth observations, validated in simulation and real-world.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种感知人形跑酷框架，利用显著性引导的时序感知模块和门控记忆，以及交替损失，使机器人仅依靠机载深度观测即可在稀疏落脚点上稳定穿越，并在仿真和真实世界中验证。
summary_zh: 尽管近期感知运动领域的进展已使人形机器人能够穿越结构化地形，但在高度不连续环境中进行敏捷跑酷仍是一个开放性的挑战。特别是，跨越稀疏的落脚点和狭窄的支撑区域需要精确的落脚点选择、视觉观测的有效利用，以及在快速过渡过程中保持一致的交替落脚。本文提出了一种感知型人形机器人跑酷框架，仅利用机载深度观测即可实现在落脚点可用性受限的地形上的稳定穿越。该框架包含一个显著性引导的时间感知模块，该模块将显著性先验与门控记忆相结合，跨帧保留信息丰富的深度特征，从而能够根据部分观测实现可靠的落脚点选择。通过引入交替损失，我们的对称正则化促进了交替步态模式，并增强了穿越的鲁棒性。大量实验表明，我们的方法在仿真和现实世界的挑战性地形上显著提高了成功率和落脚点精度。

title: TactileStep: Sole Tactile Learning for Regulating Foot-Terrain Interaction in Humanoid Locomotion
summary: Humanoid parkour policies can traverse various terrains, but task completion may mask challenges of harsh landings, edge contacts, and unstable stance contacts. Humans naturally regulate foot-terrain interaction through tactile feedback, modulating contact compliance according to terrain stiffness. This highlights a key domain gap between humans and humanoid robots: the absence of rich tactile sensing in most humanoid systems. We address this problem with TactileStep, a deployable tactile learning framework that brings sole pressure sensing into humanoid locomotion control for softer touchdowns and more stable support. TactileStep aligns tactile simulation with the real pressure insole, allowing the policy to learn from the same contact features available on hardware. During training, we use tactile and motion cues to recognize different foot-contact phases and apply phase-aware rewards that encourage safer landing and more stable stance. Evaluated in simulation and on a Unitree G1 humanoid across diverse terrains, TactileStep reduces peak touchdown force by up to 48.8% and peak A-weighted impact noise by up to 30.1 dB over a strong perceptive baseline, while increasing stance contact area by up to 23.8%.
tldr: TactileStep integrates sole tactile sensing into humanoid locomotion control, using tactile and motion cues to recognize foot-contact phases and apply phase-aware rewards, reducing impact forces and noise while increasing stance stability on the Unitree G1 across diverse terrains.
tldr_zh: TactileStep 将足底触觉感知集成到人形机器人运动控制中，利用触觉和运动线索识别足部接触阶段并应用阶段感知奖励，在 Unitree G1 上多种地形中降低了冲击力和噪声，同时增强了支撑稳定性。
summary_zh: 人形机器人的跑酷策略能够穿越多种地形，然而任务完成可能掩盖了严酷落地、边缘接触以及不稳定站立接触所带来的挑战。人类自然通过触觉反馈来调节脚与地面之间的交互，根据地形刚度调整接触顺应性。这凸显了人类与人形机器人之间的一个关键领域差距：大多数仿人系统中缺乏丰富的触觉感知能力。针对这一问题，我们提出了TactileStep，一种可部署的触觉学习框架，将足底压力传感引入人形机器人运动控制中，实现更柔和的触地以及更稳定的支撑。TactileStep将触觉模拟与真实压力鞋垫对齐，使策略能够从硬件上可用的相同接触特征中学习。在训练过程中，我们利用触觉与运动线索来识别不同的足部接触阶段，并应用与阶段相关的奖励，以鼓励更安全的落地和更稳定的站立。在仿真环境及Unitree G1人形机器人上，跨越多种地形的评估结果表明，与强感知基线相比，TactileStep将峰值触地力降低了高达48.8%，峰值A加权冲击噪声降低了高达30.1分贝，同时将站立接触面积增加了高达23.8%。

title: ActGaze: Learning Action-Grounded Gaze through Counterfactual Visual Interventions for High-Precision Manipulation
summary: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often struggle with high-precision robotic manipulation. We attribute this limitation primarily to their visual attention being dispersed across task-irrelevant regions. To address this issue, we propose ActGaze, a training approach that guides VLA policies to gaze on task-relevant regions, much like humans gaze on critical visual cues while executing precise movements. Unlike prior methods that rely on external labels for gaze supervision, ActGaze derives spatial supervision directly from the VLA's own action objective by using counterfactual visual interventions to identify regions that are critical for action prediction. Extensive real-robot experiments on four high-precision robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that ActGaze induces more focused visual attention on task-relevant regions and consistently outperforms the base VLA policy and other visual-grounding approaches.
tldr: ActGaze introduces a counterfactual visual intervention method to generate action-grounded gaze supervision for VLA policies, improving high-precision robotic manipulation by focusing attention on task-relevant regions without external labels.
tldr_zh: ActGaze提出了一种通过反事实视觉干预生成动作接地注视监督的方法，引导VLA策略关注任务相关区域，从而提升高精度机器人操作性能，无需外部标签。
summary_zh: 当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在高精度机器人操作任务中常常表现不佳。我们将这一局限主要归因于其视觉注意力分散在与任务无关的区域。为解决这一问题，我们提出ActGaze，一种训练方法，引导VLA策略将注意力聚焦于任务相关区域，类似于人类在执行精细动作时注视关键视觉线索的方式。与先前依赖外部标签进行注视监督的方法不同，ActGaze通过反事实视觉干预，直接从VLA自身的动作目标中提取空间监督信号，以识别对动作预测至关重要的区域。在四项高精度机器人操作任务上进行的大量真实机器人实验表明，ActGaze能够使视觉注意力更加集中于任务相关区域，并且始终优于基础VLA策略及其他视觉接地方法。

title: RoboRecover: Benchmarking Robot Policy Recovery under Execution Deviations
summary: Robot-policy benchmarks increasingly cover diverse tasks and preset out-of-distribution conditions, but typically evaluate complete trajectories from predefined initial states. These evaluations often focus on the initialized scene and the final outcome, while paying less attention to the dynamic interaction process. During closed-loop execution, actions and contacts can alter object relations and task progress, producing off-nominal intermediate states that need recovery. Recovery requires a policy to infer how task progress has changed, correct the relevant relations, and continue the original goal. We introduce RoboRecover, a benchmark for robot policy recovery under execution deviations. RoboRecover selects deviation states from trajectories, reconstructs them by replaying action prefixes, and evaluates policies on the original task. RoboRecover contains 2,000 scenarios across RoboTwin and LIBERO, with 1,000 scenarios and a fixed 800/200 train/test split on each platform. Results show that initial-state performance does not determine recovery performance and policies exhibit different recovery strengths across scenarios. Using its training split, RoboRecover further supports study on recovery interventions. RoboRecover establishes recovery from execution-induced intermediate states as a distinct dimension of robot policy evaluation.
tldr: RoboRecover is a benchmark for evaluating robot policy recovery from execution-induced intermediate states, containing 2,000 scenarios across RoboTwin and LIBERO, and showing recovery performance is distinct from initial-state performance.
tldr_zh: RoboRecover 是一个用于评估机器人策略在执行偏差下恢复能力的基准，包含 RoboTwin 和 LIBERO 上的 2000 个场景，表明恢复性能与初始状态性能不同。
summary_zh: 机器人策略基准测试日益涵盖多样化任务和预设的分布外条件，但通常仅从预定义的初始状态评估完整轨迹。这些评估往往聚焦于初始化场景和最终结果，而对动态交互过程的关注相对不足。在闭环执行过程中，动作和接触可能改变物体关系及任务进度，产生需要恢复的非标称中间状态。恢复要求策略能够推断任务进度发生了何种变化，修正相关关系，并继续执行原始目标。我们提出RoboRecover，一个面向执行偏差下机器人策略恢复的基准测试。RoboRecover从轨迹中选取偏差状态，通过重放动作前缀对其进行重建，并在原始任务上评估策略。RoboRecover包含来自RoboTwin和LIBERO的2,000个场景，每个平台各有1,000个场景，并采用固定的800/200训练/测试划分。结果表明，初始状态下的性能并不能决定恢复性能，且不同策略在不同场景中表现出各异的恢复能力。利用其训练划分，RoboRecover进一步支持恢复干预措施的研究。RoboRecover将执行引发的中间状态下的恢复确立为机器人策略评估的一个独立维度。

title: Uncertainty-Gated Exploration Noise Suppresses Task Collapse in Online RL Fine-Tuning of a Flow-Matching Vision-Language-Action Policy
summary: Online reinforcement learning fine-tuning of pretrained flow-matching vision-language-action (VLA) policies promises robots that keep learning after deployment, but continued updates often destroy competence on individual tasks while the aggregate still looks healthy. We study this failure mode, which we call task collapse, under a matched small-compute budget on LIBERO-10 with a 450M-parameter SmolVLA policy trained by PPO with stochastic (SDE) sampling. Three exploration-noise policies differ in one live variable: a fixed noise scale, a ReinFlow-style learned noise network, and an uncertainty-gated controller that redistributes exploration across task streams from task-agnostic novelty and competence signals, without task labels or episode boundaries. Under the pooled definition, fixed noise collapses tasks in two of three seeds and learned noise in every seed measured to iteration 200, while the controller collapses none in any of its three seeds. Measured parameter displacement shows the controller's action expert keeps changing, while its mean applied noise is close to the fixed scale in the available logs. The matched comparison supports the controller's effect on task preservation; the separate contributions of its adaptation across states and over time are not disentangled. A lower fixed scale slows the decline but does not stop it. No arm improves on the behavior-cloning baseline in this budget. Two properties of that regime are measured beside this result, not offered as its cause: following the reference recipe, training runs in bfloat16 with no fp32 master copy, under which 96.02% of the action expert's elements stay bit-identical across three consecutive iterations, and an fp32 master copy at the reference learning rate collapses both arms in a single-seed observation. We release tools measuring per-task collapse under four definitions, rescoring noise and instrument tares.
tldr: This paper investigates task collapse during online RL fine-tuning of a flow-matching VLA policy on LIBERO-10, and proposes an uncertainty-gated exploration noise controller that suppresses task collapse better than fixed or learned noise schemes, while also highlighting potential numerical precision issues in bfloat16 training.
tldr_zh: 本文研究了在线强化学习微调流匹配VLA策略时出现的任务崩溃现象，并提出一种不确定性门控的探索噪声控制器，在LIBERO-10上相比固定或学习噪声方案更有效地抑制任务崩溃，同时指出了bfloat16训练中潜在的数值精度问题。
summary_zh: 在线强化学习微调预训练的流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略有望让机器人在部署后持续学习，但持续更新往往会在单个任务上破坏能力，而总体指标看起来仍然正常。我们研究了这种被称为“任务崩溃”的失效模式，在LIBERO-10上以匹配的小计算预算进行实验，使用450M参数的SmolVLA策略，通过带有随机（SDE）采样的PPO进行训练。三种探索噪声策略在一个活跃变量上有所不同：固定噪声尺度、ReinFlow风格的学习噪声网络，以及一种基于不确定性门控的控制器，它根据任务无关的新颖性和能力信号在各任务流之间重新分配探索，无需任务标签或回合边界。在汇总定义下，固定噪声在三个种子中的两个中导致任务崩溃，学习噪声在每个种子中均崩溃至迭代200，而控制器在其三个种子中均无崩溃。测得的参数位移显示控制器的动作专家持续变化，而其平均施加噪声在可用日志中接近固定尺度。匹配比较支持控制器对任务保留的效果；其跨状态和跨时间的适应性各自贡献未被分离。较低的固定尺度减缓了衰退但未阻止它。在该预算下，没有任何方案优于行为克隆基线。除了这一结果外，我们还测量了该制度的两个属性，并非将其作为原因提出：按照参考配方，训练以bfloat16运行且无fp32主副本，在此条件下动作专家元素的96.02%在连续三次迭代中保持位相同；而在参考学习率下使用fp32主副本在单种子观察中导致两个方案均崩溃。我们发布了在四种定义下测量每个任务崩溃的工具，以及噪声重评分和仪器校准工具。

title: KeyGen: Unsupervised Keypoint based Object-Centric Representations for Category-Level Policy Generalization
summary: Generalization in robotic manipulation requires policies to perform tasks across diverse unseen object instances that vary in shape, size, and pose. However, conventional behavior cloning (BC) methods often overfit to instance-specific geometry and appearance, limiting transfer to novel objects. We introduce KeyGen, a framework that learns canonicalized semantic 3D keypoints from point clouds and uses them as structured object-centric representations for policy learning. A visuomotor diffusion policy conditions on these keypoints together with object-centric geometry to predict full manipulation trajectories, enabling consistent geometric correspondence across object instances. To evaluate category-level generalization, we construct a photorealistic simulation benchmark with three manipulation tasks and a planning-driven data generation pipeline that produces expert trajectories across diverse object instances. Experiments show that KeyGen significantly outperforms prior methods on both seen and unseen objects under pose variation, scales effectively with additional demonstrations per object, maintains robustness to object rescaling, and achieves strong performance in both simulation and real-world manipulation.
tldr: KeyGen learns canonicalized semantic 3D keypoints from point clouds as structured object-centric representations for visuomotor diffusion policies, improving category-level manipulation generalization across unseen object instances in simulation and real world.
tldr_zh: KeyGen 从点云中学习规范化语义 3D 关键点，作为结构化对象中心表示用于视觉运动扩散策略，从而提升跨未见对象实例的类别级操作泛化能力，并在仿真和真实世界中均取得良好效果。
summary_zh: 泛化能力对于机器人操作至关重要，要求策略能够应对形状、尺寸和位姿各异的大量未见物体实例。然而，传统的行为克隆（BC）方法往往过拟合于物体实例特有的几何外观特征，限制了对新物体的迁移能力。为此，我们提出KeyGen框架，该框架从点云中学习规范化的语义3D关键点，并将其作为面向物体的结构化表征用于策略学习。一种视觉运动扩散策略以这些关键点及物体中心几何信息为条件，预测完整的操作轨迹，从而在物体实例间建立一致的几何对应关系。为评估类别级泛化性能，我们构建了一个包含三项操作任务的逼真仿真基准，并设计了一条规划驱动的数据生成流水线，用于生成覆盖多种物体实例的专家轨迹。实验表明，KeyGen在位姿变化条件下的已见与未见物体上均显著优于现有方法，且随着每个物体演示数量的增加表现出良好的扩展性，对物体尺度变化具有鲁棒性，并在仿真及真实世界操作中均取得了优异性能。

title: FlyCNS: Connectome-Grounded Information Organization for Communication-Constrained Embodied Control
summary: Robotic bodies are inherently distributed in sensing and actuation, yet learning-based control still commonly relies on centralized information processing. This work studies the problem of information organization in communication-constrained embodied control: which computations should remain local, and which information is worth transmitting for whole-body coordination. We propose FlyCNS, an embodied information-organization framework inspired by the Drosophila brain--nerve-cord connectome. FlyCNS preserves local sensorimotor computation within each limb and enables selective long-range communication through separate ascending and descending routing pathways. From a real connectome, FlyCNS extracts the directional structural complexity of these two pathway types and uses it as a weak prior over communication allocation, while message content, transmission timing, and locomotion policies remain task-adaptive and are learned through reinforcement learning. In Unitree Go1 simulation, FlyCNS exhibits more graceful performance degradation as the communication budget is tightened. Under the most restrictive setting, it uses only about 21--22\% of the communication of the full-communication reference, while still maintaining a tracking score of approximately 0.882 under both command protocols, with a gap of no more than 6.1\% from the full-communication reference. These results indicate that real neural connectomes can inform not only the structural design of control networks, but also provide transferable inductive biases for information organization across embodiments, guiding robots in balancing local computation and long-range coordination under limited communication resources.
tldr: FlyCNS draws inspiration from the Drosophila connectome to design a communication-constrained framework for embodied control, using directional pathway complexity as a prior for selective information routing. It demonstrates graceful performance degradation in Unitree Go1 simulation, maintaining high tracking scores with significantly reduced inter-limb communication.
tldr_zh: FlyCNS 从果蝇连接组中汲取灵感，为通信受限的具身控制设计信息组织框架，利用通路方向性结构复杂度作为选择性通信的先验，并在 Unitree Go1 仿真中展现了优雅的性能退化，以显著降低的通信量维持高跟踪得分。
summary_zh: 机器人本体的感知与执行在物理上天然是分布式的，然而基于学习的控制方法仍普遍依赖集中式信息处理。本研究关注通信受限的具身控制中的信息组织问题：哪些计算应保留在局部，哪些信息值得为全身协调而传输。我们提出FlyCNS，一种受果蝇脑—神经索连接组启发的具身信息组织框架。FlyCNS在每个肢体内部保留局部感觉运动计算，并通过独立的上升与下降路由通路实现选择性长距离通信。FlyCNS从真实连接组中提取这两类通路的定向结构复杂度，并将其作为通信分配的弱先验，而消息内容、传输时机及运动策略则保持任务自适应，通过强化学习获得。在Unitree Go1仿真中，随着通信预算收紧，FlyCNS表现出更优雅的性能退化。在最严格的设置下，其通信量仅为全通信基准的约21\%—22\%，同时在两种指令协议下仍保持约0.882的跟踪得分，与全通信基准的差距不超过6.1\%。这些结果表明，真实神经连接组不仅可以为控制网络的结构设计提供启示，还能为跨本体的信息组织提供可迁移的归纳偏置，引导机器人在有限通信资源下平衡局部计算与长距离协调。

title: OCC4M: Object-Centric 4D Memory for Spatiotemporal Reasoning in Long-Horizon Manipulation
summary: Long-horizon manipulation often requires reasoning about state absent from the current view, such as a vanished object's location, temporal identity, or the contents of a shuffled container. We present OCC4M ("Occam"), an object-centric 4D memory that maintains persistent tracks in a shared world frame and explicitly represents temporal, motion, and containment relations. A vision-language model (VLM) queries this structured memory to select actionable targets for history-free low-level execution. Across seven simulation conditions and 350 episodes, OCC4M achieves 96.6% memory success and 88.9% end-to-end success, versus 54.6% and 57.7% for FrameSamp, a raw-history VLM baseline using Gemini 3.7 Flash with the complete observation history and the same executor. In a controlled viewpoint-transfer test, OCC4M maintains 100% memory and 98% end-to-end success after a viewpoint change, while full-history FrameSamp falls to near-zero success. On 20 fixed-camera Franka episodes, OCC4M reaches 85% joint memory accuracy, versus at most 30% for FrameSamp across context sizes from $K=16$ to the complete history, and completes 45% of full two-stage tasks. These results support explicit object-centric memory for persistent spatiotemporal reasoning in long-horizon manipulation. Qualitative videos are available at https://occ4m-sup.github.io/occ4m-supplementary/.
tldr: OCC4M introduces an object-centric 4D memory that maintains persistent object tracks in a world frame, queried by a VLM for long-horizon manipulation, significantly outperforming raw-history baselines in simulation and real-robot experiments.
tldr_zh: OCC4M提出了一种以对象为中心的4D记忆，在世界坐标系中维护持久对象轨迹，并由VLM查询以支持长时程操作，在仿真和真实机器人实验中显著优于原始历史基线。
summary_zh: 长时程操作任务通常需要对当前视野中缺失的状态进行推理，例如消失物体的位置、时间身份，或被打乱容器中的内容。我们提出OCC4M（“Occam”），一种以对象为中心的4D记忆系统，它在共享世界坐标系中维持持久轨迹，并显式建模时间、运动和包含关系。视觉语言模型（VLM）查询这一结构化记忆，以选择可直接执行的无历史低级动作目标。在七种仿真条件和350个回合中，OCC4M实现了96.6%的记忆成功率和88.9%的端到端成功率，而使用Gemini 3.7 Flash并接收完整观测历史及相同执行器的原始历史VLM基线FrameSamp分别仅为54.6%和57.7%。在受控的视角迁移测试中，OCC4M在视角变化后仍保持100%的记忆成功率和98%的端到端成功率，而使用完整历史的FrameSamp则降至接近零。在20个固定相机Franka回合中，OCC4M达到了85%的联合记忆准确率，而FrameSamp在从上下文大小K=16到完整历史的各种条件下最高仅为30%，并完成了45%的完整两阶段任务。这些结果支持以对象为中心的显式记忆在长时程操作中进行持久时空推理的有效性。定性视频见 https://occ4m-sup.github.io/occ4m-supplementary/。

title: Morphometric Imitation: From Morphology and Contact Aware Hand Retargeting to Sim-to-Real Visuomotor Policy
summary: Human hand-object interactions (HOIs) provide a rich source of demonstrations for dexterous manipulation, but learning directly from them presents challenges in bridging morphology gaps, ensuring dynamical feasibility, and sim-to-real deployment. We present Morphometric Imitation, a three-stage framework that transforms reconstructed HOIs into zero-shot sim-to-real visuomotor policies. First, morphometric optimization (MMO) kinematically retargets human motion across hand morphologies while preserving demonstrated contacts. Second, residual reinforcement learning (RL) refines the kinematic reference using object pose and contact information from the human motion to produce dynamically feasible robot demonstrations. Third, these demonstrations are distilled into visuomotor policies. Across three robot hands and ten HOIs, MMO improves contact F1 over the strongest of five baselines by at least 8 points for every hand, while also improving the success rate of downstream dynamic retargeting by as much as 35 points. Ablations on the residual RL show complementary benefits from using object pose and contact information. Finally, the visuomotor policies achieve 89.3% zero-shot success in 300 real-world trials on 30 objects. Project page: $\href{https://morphometricimitation.github.io}{\text{this https URL}}$
tldr: This paper introduces Morphometric Imitation, a three-stage framework that retargets human hand-object interactions to different robot hands via morphometric optimization and residual RL, then distills the resulting demonstrations into visuomotor policies that achieve high zero-shot sim-to-real success on real robots.
tldr_zh: 本文提出形态模仿，一个三阶段框架，通过形态度量和残差强化学习将人类手物交互重定向到不同机器人手，并将示范蒸馏为视觉运动策略，在真实机器人上实现了高零样本成功率。
summary_zh: 人类手物交互（HOIs）为灵巧操作提供了丰富的演示来源，但直接从中学习面临着跨越形态差异、确保动力学可行性以及模拟到现实部署等挑战。我们提出了形态测量模仿（Morphometric Imitation），这是一个三阶段框架，可将重建的手物交互转化为零样本的模拟到现实视觉运动策略。首先，形态测量优化（MMO）在运动学层面跨手部形态重定向人体动作，同时保留已展示的接触信息。其次，残差强化学习（RL）利用人体动作中的物体位姿和接触信息对运动学参考进行细化，以生成动力学上可行的机器人演示。最后，这些演示被提炼为视觉运动策略。在三种机器人手和十种手物交互中，MMO相较五种基线中最强者，每只手的接触F1分数至少提高8个百分点，同时下游动态重定向的成功率最多提升35个百分点。对残差RL的消融实验表明，利用物体位姿和接触信息具有互补性收益。最终，视觉运动策略在30个物体的300次真实世界试验中实现了89.3%的零样本成功率。项目页面：\href{https://morphometricimitation.github.io}{\text{https://morphometricimitation.github.io}}

title: S2Planner: Multi-Scale Semantic Planner for End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: We present S2Planner, a trajectory planner that combines three front-facing cameras with ego-motion history and the current driving command. A fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone and a Spatial Tuning Adapter produce multi-scale image features; a coarse-to-fine decoder then uses trajectory self-attention and camera-projected cross-attention to refine candidate waypoints. The contribution is the integration of ego-conditioned trajectory initialization with iterative, geometry-guided sampling of multi-scale image features, rather than a new visual backbone or attention operator. On the NAVSIM v1 non-reactive evaluation, the previously reported navtest run obtained 88.03 PDMS. Because that run was selected using navtest performance, this number is exploratory and cannot be interpreted as an unbiased test estimate. Validation-selected evaluation on unexposed data, repeated runs, and computational measurements are needed to establish generalization and efficiency.
tldr: S2Planner presents a multi-scale semantic trajectory planner for end-to-end autonomous driving, using a fine-tuned DINOv3 backbone with a Spatial Tuning Adapter and a coarse-to-fine decoder with trajectory self-attention and camera-projected cross-attention. It integrates ego-conditioned trajectory initialization with iterative, geometry-guided sampling of multi-scale image features, evaluated on NAVSIM v1; however, the reported PDMS score is exploratory and requires further validation.
tldr_zh: S2Planner 提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的多尺度语义轨迹规划器，采用微调的 DINOv3 骨干网络和空间调优适配器，以及带有轨迹自注意力和相机投影交叉注意力的由粗到精解码器。其贡献在于将自我条件轨迹初始化与多尺度图像特征的迭代、几何引导采样相结合，并在 NAVSIM v1 上进行了评估；然而，报告的 PDMS 分数是探索性的，需要进一步验证。
summary_zh: 我们提出了S2Planner，一种结合三个前视摄像头、自车运动历史及当前驾驶指令的轨迹规划器。通过微调的DINOv3骨干网络与空间调谐适配器生成多尺度图像特征；随后，由粗到细的解码器利用轨迹自注意力与相机投影交叉注意力来优化候选路径点。本工作的贡献在于将自车条件化的轨迹初始化与基于几何引导的多尺度图像特征迭代采样相结合，而非提出新的视觉骨干网络或注意力算子。在NAVSIM v1非反应式评估中，先前报告的navtest测试运行获得了88.03 PDMS得分。由于该运行结果基于navtest性能进行选择，因此该数值属于探索性结果，不能解释为无偏的测试估计。需要在未接触过的数据上进行基于验证集选择的评估、重复运行及计算量测量，以确定其泛化能力与效率。

title: Learning from Mixed-Quality Deployment Experience for Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot policies deployed in real environments naturally accumulate mixed-quality experience, including successful executions, partial progress, and failures. Although these rollouts provide valuable information for further learning, directly incorporating them into imitation learning may reinforce undesirable behaviors, while offline reinforcement learning often suffers from unreliable value estimation under sparse rewards and limited data coverage. We consider a practical post-deployment setting where learning relies only on naturally accumulated autonomous rollouts, without additional human corrections or exploratory interaction. To effectively exploit such experience, we propose Predictive Action Chunk Learning (PACL). PACL first learns a predictive chunk-level critic that evaluates temporally extended action sequences and augments temporal difference learning with future latent prediction, providing richer supervision for long-horizon value estimation. The learned critic then converts chunk-level Q-values into discrete quality conditions, which guide a diffusion actor to learn jointly from these mixed-quality experiences without treating all behaviors as equivalent supervision. At inference, the actor generates multiple action chunks and the critic selects the highest valued candidate. Experiments across simulated and real-world robot manipulation tasks show that PACL consistently improves the pretrained policy and outperforms strong imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning baselines.
tldr: PACL is a method for learning from mixed-quality robot deployment data by training a chunk-level critic with future latent prediction and using its Q-values to condition a diffusion actor, improving pretrained manipulation policies.
tldr_zh: PACL 通过训练一个带有未来潜在预测的块级评论家，并利用其 Q 值来条件扩散 actor，从而从混合质量的机器人部署数据中学习，提升预训练操作策略。
summary_zh:
摘要：
在真实环境中部署的机器人策略自然会产生混合质量的体验，包括成功执行、部分进展和失败。尽管这些轨迹数据为进一步学习提供了有价值的信息，但直接将它们纳入模仿学习可能会强化不良行为，而离线强化学习在稀疏奖励和有限数据覆盖下往往面临价值估计不可靠的问题。我们考虑一种实用的部署后场景，其中学习仅依赖于自然积累的自主轨迹数据，无需额外的人工纠正或探索性交互。为了有效利用此类经验，我们提出了预测性动作块学习（PACL）。PACL首先学习一个预测性的块级评论家，用于评估时间上扩展的动作序列，并通过未来潜在状态预测增强时序差分学习，为长视野价值估计提供更丰富的监督信号。随后，学习到的评论家将块级Q值转化为离散的质量条件，引导扩散式动作生成器从这些混合质量的经验中联合学习，而不将所有行为视为等同的监督信号。在推理阶段，动作生成器生成多个动作块，评论家选择价值最高的候选。在模拟和真实机器人操作任务上的实验表明，PACL能够持续改进预训练策略，并超越强模仿学习和离线强化学习基线方法。

title: ReVAMP: Vector-Accelerated Motion Planning for Kinematically-Constrained Systems via Reparameterization
summary: Robots often must satisfy one or more constraints during motion planning for real-world tasks. When such constraints reduce the valid configuration space to a measure-zero subset, sampling based planning algorithms require modifications to draw feasible samples. For many common end-effector constraints, parameterizations built on inverse kinematics (IK) provide an alternate formulation where the constraints are satisfied by construction, allowing directly sampling the feasible set. Despite their elegant approach, parameterized planners have remained slower than vector-accelerated implementations of projection-based approaches, leaving their performance ceiling an open question. We explore a new axis of vectorization built upon reparameterizing the planning space through analytic IK. This approach addresses existing inefficiencies in vectorized projection-based planners and exposes new opportunities for parallelism within the planner. We show that the planner can synthesize plans in microseconds to milliseconds for high dimensional systems (up to 20 dimensions), with complex constraints, up to 10x faster than the current state-of-the-art. Furthermore, we demonstrate how such planning speeds open up avenues for restructuring sequential manipulation pipelines.
tldr: ReVAMP accelerates vectorized motion planning for kinematically constrained robots by reparameterizing the configuration space through analytic IK, achieving up to 10x speedup over state-of-the-art and enabling microsecond-to-millisecond planning for high-dimensional systems.
tldr_zh: ReVAMP 通过解析逆运动学对配置空间进行重新参数化，加速了运动学约束机器人的向量化运动规划，相比现有技术实现了高达10倍的加速，并为高维系统提供了微秒到毫秒级的规划能力。
summary_zh: 机器人通常需要在运动规划过程中满足一个或多个约束条件，以完成实际任务。当这些约束将有效构型空间缩减至零测度子集时，基于采样的规划算法需要进行改进，以生成可行样本。对于许多常见的末端执行器约束，基于逆运动学（IK）构建的参数化方法提供了一种替代表述，使约束在构造过程中即被满足，从而能够直接对可行集进行采样。尽管参数化规划器的方法简洁优雅，但其运行速度仍慢于基于投影方法且采用矢量加速的实现方案，其性能上限仍是一个未解问题。我们探索了一种新的向量化维度，其基础是通过解析逆运动学对规划空间进行重新参数化。该方法解决了现有向量化投影规划器在效率上的不足，并在规划器内部开辟了新的并行化机会。我们证明，该规划器能够在微秒至毫秒级别内为高维系统（最高达20维）在复杂约束条件下合成规划路径，速度比当前最先进方法快达10倍。此外，我们还展示了这种规划速度如何为重构顺序操作流水线提供新的途径。

title: Training-free Behavior Cloning
summary: Neural behavior cloning compresses demonstrations into large models, making individual actions difficult to trace and policy updates costly. Retrieval policies retain access to demonstrations but struggle with mismatch between recorded and live behavior. We introduce Behavior Predictive Control (BPC), which synthesizes policies without end-to-end policy training by combining an action-aware retrieval metric, a Hankel-based action-continuation prior, and a closed-form one-step residual correction. Inspired by behavioral systems theory, BPC predicts future actions by blending stored observation-action data that best reconstructs the recent runtime observation--action history. Across simulated benchmarks and real-robot deployments, BPC is competitive with learned policies such as $π_{0.5}$ (surpassing it in some cases), while reducing policy fitting from hours to seconds on consumer GPUs and supporting closed-loop control upwards of 75 Hz on a Jetson Orin Nano. The retrieved demonstration windows and their coefficients also provide an intrinsic estimate of task progress. Retaining demonstrations within the deployed policy makes its predictions traceable to supporting trajectories and enables behavior revision through the demonstration bank.
tldr: This paper proposes Behavior Predictive Control (BPC), a training-free behavior cloning method that synthesizes robot policies by blending stored demonstrations with a closed-form residual correction, eliminating end-to-end policy training. BPC matches or exceeds learned policies like π0.5 on simulated and real robot tasks while enabling traceable predictions and real-time control on edge hardware.
tldr_zh: 本文提出行为预测控制（BPC），一种无需训练的机器人行为克隆方法，通过融合存储的示范轨迹与闭环残差校正来合成策略，省去了端到端策略训练。在仿真和真实机器人任务中，BPC的性能媲美甚至超越π0.5等学习策略，并支持边缘设备上的实时控制与可追溯的预测。
summary_zh: 神经行为克隆将示范数据压缩进大型模型中，导致单个动作难以追溯，且策略更新成本高昂。检索式策略虽保留了对示范数据的访问权，但在记录行为与实时行为不一致时存在适配问题。我们提出行为预测控制（BPC），该方法无需端到端策略训练即可合成策略，通过结合动作感知检索度量、基于Hankel矩阵的动作延续先验，以及闭式一步残差校正实现。受行为系统理论启发，BPC通过融合最能重建近期运行时观测-动作历史片段的存储观测-动作数据来预测未来动作。在模拟基准测试和真实机器人部署中，BPC与诸如\( \pi_{0.5} \)等学习型策略表现相当（在某些情况下甚至超越），同时将策略拟合时间从数小时缩短至消费级GPU上的数秒，并能在Jetson Orin Nano上支持超过75 Hz的闭环控制。检索到的示范窗口及其系数还可提供任务进展的内在估计。部署策略中保留示范数据使其预测可追溯至支撑轨迹，并支持通过示范库实现行为修订。

title: Faster Visuomotor Policy Learning on Action Manifolds via Riemannian MeanFlow
summary: Visuomotor policies learn a direct map from raw sensory observations to robot action sequences. Policies based on Diffusion and Flow Matching capture the multimodal distribution over action sequences in an end-to-end manner. This expressivity comes at the cost of multi-step numerical integration of the learned vector field for action generation, which can be expensive and time-consuming, impeding fast control rates required in robotics applications. Furthermore, robot action sequences are usually defined on a smooth, differentiable manifold, requiring that the learned policy respects the intrinsic geometry of the robot's action space. Here, we present Riemannian MeanFlow Policy (RMFP), which learns the conditioned flow map of the probability path on the robot action manifold. Our formulation employs a flow map consistency objective grounded in the data by a Riemannian Conditional Flow Matching anchor. The flow map consistency condition is stable to train and constrains the learned model to finite-time transport, which yields on-manifold action sequence generation with as few as one network function evaluation. We present results on the spherical LASA and Push-T benchmarks, on the Tool Hang and Transport tasks of the Robomimic suite, and on the Franka Kitchen task with manifold-constrained action generation, and demonstrate that RMFP attains performance competitive with prior work at a lower sampling cost. We also employ RMFP on a real-world robotic manipulation task to demonstrate fast action generation under imperfect sensor measurements in the physical world.
tldr: This paper introduces Riemannian MeanFlow Policy (RMFP), a flow-matching-based visuomotor policy that learns a consistent flow map on the robot's action manifold, enabling on-manifold action generation with as few as one network evaluation for fast control rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了黎曼均流策略（RMFP），一种基于流匹配的视觉运动策略，在机器人动作流形上学习一致的流映射，实现仅需一次网络评估即可生成流形上的动作，从而加快控制频率。
summary_zh: 视觉运动策略学习从原始感官观测到机器人动作序列的直接映射。基于扩散和流匹配的策略以端到端方式捕捉动作序列上的多模态分布。这种表达能力以对学习到的向量场进行多步数值积分以生成动作序列为代价，这一过程可能昂贵且耗时，阻碍了机器人应用中所需的快速控制频率。此外，机器人动作序列通常定义在光滑可微的流形上，要求学习到的策略尊重机器人动作空间的内在几何结构。在此，我们提出黎曼均值流策略（RMFP），该策略学习机器人动作流形上概率路径的条件流映射。我们的公式采用由黎曼条件流匹配锚定在数据上的流映射一致性目标。流映射一致性条件训练稳定，并将学习到的模型约束为有限时间传输，从而仅需一次网络函数评估即可生成流形上的动作序列。我们在球形LASA和Push-T基准测试、Robomimic套件的Tool Hang和Transport任务以及具有流形约束动作生成的Franka Kitchen任务上展示了结果，并证明RMFP以更低的采样成本达到了与先前工作相当的性能。我们还将RMFP应用于真实世界的机器人操作任务，以展示在物理世界中传感器测量不完善的情况下快速动作生成的能力。

title: Real-Time Force Regulation for Whole-Hand Dexterous Grasping
summary: Robust dexterous grasping requires maintaining physical stability despite contacts interactively evolving across the entire hand. A precomputed force distribution can easily fail under object motion, modeling errors, or external disturbances. In this paper, we present a framework for real-time force regulation over dynamically changing whole-hand contacts. Our method geometrically estimates contacts across all hand links using a tracked object model and proprioception, without requiring tactile sensing at those contacts. It repeatedly recomputes the desired contact-force distribution subject to friction constraints, actuator limits, and an actuation-consistency constraint motivated by classical whole-limb force analysis. We integrate this force-regulation controller with reactive reaching, enabling the hand to acquire a grasp, maintain it under disturbances, and regrasp after losing the object. Simulation experiments without gravity demonstrate improved grasp retention over fixed-allocation and fingertip-only execution under controlled perturbations, while real-world experiments on a 27-DoF arm-hand system demonstrate grasp maintenance and recovery under human-applied disturbances as contacts evolve across the whole hand. Project page: https://sangminkim-99.github.io/reactive-grasp-whole-hand/
tldr: This paper introduces a real-time force regulation framework for whole-hand dexterous grasping that maintains grasp stability under disturbances by repeatedly recomputing contact-force distributions without tactile sensing, demonstrated on a 27-DoF arm-hand system.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于全手灵巧抓取实时力调节框架，无需触觉传感即可在扰动下保持抓取稳定性，并在27自由度臂手系统上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 鲁棒灵巧抓取要求在与整个手部接触点动态演变的过程中维持物理稳定性。预计算的力分布容易在物体运动、建模误差或外部扰动下失效。本文提出一种框架，用于在动态变化的整手接触中实现实时力调节。该方法利用跟踪物体模型与本体感觉，几何估计所有手部连杆上的接触，而无需依赖接触处的触觉传感。该方法在摩擦约束、执行器极限以及由经典整肢力分析启发的驱动一致性约束下，反复重新计算期望接触力分布。我们将该力调节控制器与反应式伸手运动相集成，使手部能够获取抓取、在扰动下维持抓取，并在失去物体后重新抓取。无重力仿真实验表明，在受控扰动下，该方法相较于固定分配和仅指尖执行具有更好的抓取保持能力；而在27自由度手臂-手系统上的真实实验中，则展示了在人体施加扰动、接触点遍布整手演变时，系统能够维持抓取并恢复。项目页面：https://sangminkim-99.github.io/reactive-grasp-whole-hand/

title: MorphIK: Morphology-Conditioned Neural Inverse Kinematics for Unknown Robots
summary: Neural models can learn to generate various solutions to the inverse kinematics problem from data, but are usually limited to a single robot. We present MorphIK, a flow-matching model that solves inverse kinematics for revolute-joint-based kinematic chains it has never seen during training. The model uses a transformer architecture to encode the robot's morphology along with the target pose. This encoding then conditions a flow-matching head that generates poses from noise. Trained on purely synthetic data from procedurally generated robots, the model reaches a precision of about 5 cm on unseen real-world robots with 6 to 9 Degrees of Freedom. For higher precision, the model serves as an excellent Prior for further optimization algorithms, reducing error to less than 1 cm after a single step of Damped Least Squares optimization and to sub-1 mm error after 3 steps in most cases. Building on flow matching's generative capabilities to produce highly diverse outputs, our model can efficiently sample the robot's null space, providing a wide variety of configurations for the same pose. Thus, overall, MorphIK allows learning and generalizing neural inverse kinematics for a multitude of known and unknown robots.
tldr: MorphIK is a flow-matching model that learns to solve inverse kinematics for unseen robots by conditioning on the robot's morphology, achieving ~5 cm precision on unknown real-world robots and serving as a prior for optimization to reach sub-mm accuracy.
tldr_zh: MorphIK 是一种流匹配模型，通过条件化机器人形态来为未见过的机器人求解逆运动学，在未知真实机器人上达到约 5 厘米的精度，并作为优化先验可达到亚毫米精度。
summary_zh: 神经模型可以从数据中学习生成逆运动学问题的多种解决方案，但通常仅限于单一机器人。我们提出了MorphIK，一种流匹配模型，能够为训练期间从未见过的基于旋转关节的运动链求解逆运动学问题。该模型采用Transformer架构来编码机器人的形态结构以及目标位姿。这种编码随后用于条件化一个流匹配头，从噪声中生成关节位姿。该模型仅在程序化生成的机器人的纯合成数据上训练，即可在未见过的真实机器人（具有6至9个自由度）上达到约5厘米的精度。为了获得更高的精度，该模型可作为进一步优化算法的优秀先验，经过一步阻尼最小二乘优化后误差降至不足1厘米，在大多数情况下经过三步优化后误差降至亚毫米级。基于流匹配生成能力产生高度多样化输出的特点，我们的模型能够高效地对机器人的零空间进行采样，为同一目标位姿提供多种多样的构型。因此，总体而言，MorphIK使得神经逆运动学能够学习并泛化适用于多种已知和未知机器人。

title: Retrieve-to-Localize: Bridging Large Language Models and LiDAR Geometry for Spatial Grounding
summary: LiDAR provides precise geometric information for spatial perception tasks such as object detection in autonomous driving and outdoor robotics. However, recognizing and localizing individual objects is not sufficient to answer questions that require composing spatial relations and grounding the intended target. Motivated by recent advances in large language models (LLMs) for autonomous driving, we leverage their language priors to interpret complex spatial questions and ground the referred target in LiDAR geometry. To support this spatial grounding capability, we introduce SpatialLiDAR-QA, which combines single- and multi-step relational grounding with complementary spatial understanding tasks. We further propose SpatialLiDAR-LM, which aligns LiDAR point features with an LLM and grounds target coordinates through language-conditioned, position-aware proposal retrieval and local point refinement. This design derives target coordinates directly from local LiDAR geometry rather than through textual language decoding. Experiments demonstrate substantial improvements over representative LiDAR--language models and multi-camera VLMs on precise coordinate prediction tasks. Our dataset and model training code will be publicly released.
tldr: The paper introduces SpatialLiDAR-QA and SpatialLiDAR-LM to ground spatial queries in LiDAR geometry by aligning point features with LLMs and using language-conditioned proposal retrieval and local refinement, improving precise coordinate prediction for autonomous driving and outdoor robotics.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出了 SpatialLiDAR-QA 和 SpatialLiDAR-LM，通过将激光雷达点特征与LLM对齐，并利用语言条件化的提案检索和局部细化来在激光雷达几何中定位空间查询的目标，提高了自动驾驶和户外机器人中精确坐标预测的性能。
summary_zh: 摘要：激光雷达为自动驾驶和户外机器人中的目标检测等空间感知任务提供了精确的几何信息。然而，识别并定位单个目标不足以回答那些需要组合空间关系并确定所指目标的问题。受近期大语言模型（LLM）在自动驾驶领域进展的启发，我们利用其语言先验来解读复杂的空间问题，并在激光雷达几何中确定所指目标。为支持这种空间定位能力，我们引入了SpatialLiDAR-QA，它将单步和多步关系定位与互补的空间理解任务相结合。我们进一步提出了SpatialLiDAR-LM，它将激光雷达点特征与大语言模型对齐，并通过基于语言条件、位置感知的提案检索和局部点细化来确定目标坐标。该设计直接从局部激光雷达几何中导出目标坐标，而非通过文本语言解码。实验表明，在精确坐标预测任务中，我们相较于代表性的激光雷达-语言模型和多摄像头视觉语言模型取得了显著改进。我们的数据集和模型训练代码将公开发布。

title: From Target Selection to Digging: A Learning-Based Framework for Continuous Autonomous Excavation
summary: Repeated excavation continuously reshapes pile geometry, requiring an autonomous excavator to adapt its digging targets and coordinate motion across successive excavation cycles. We present a learning-based framework for continuous autonomous excavation that integrates terrain-aware target selection with reinforcement- and imitation-learning controllers. The framework separates target-conditioned motion from local digging: a shared task-conditioned RL policy controls waypoint-guided approach and loaded transport, while an IL policy learns vision-based digging and lifting from expert demonstrations. Digging targets are selected from LiDAR elevation maps and converted into bucket-tip waypoints for motion control. The control architecture coordinates the learned policies and deterministic unloading through a shared motion interface. The complete system is deployed on a scaled hydraulic excavator with multimodal sensing and closed-loop actuator control. Offline replay and physical experiments demonstrate more consistent target selection, shorter local motion time, and increased payload compared with the respective baselines. The learned digging policy achieves a mean payload of 6.52 kg per completed cycle, compared with 2.68 kg for Fixed Dig. Three five-scoop runs further demonstrate consecutive autonomous excavation under continuously changing pile geometry.
tldr: A learning-based framework for continuous autonomous excavation integrates task-conditioned RL for motion and IL for vision-based digging, deployed on a scaled hydraulic excavator with LiDAR-based target selection, demonstrating improved payload and consecutive operation.
tldr_zh: 一个基于学习的连续自主挖掘框架，结合任务条件强化学习控制运动与模仿学习进行视觉挖掘，并在缩比液压挖掘机上部署，通过LiDAR选点提升了有效载荷并实现了连续作业。
summary_zh: 重复性挖掘作业会持续改变料堆几何形态，这就要求自主挖掘机在连续挖掘周期中不断调整挖掘目标并协调运动。本文提出了一种基于学习的连续自主挖掘框架，该框架将地形感知目标选择与强化学习和模仿学习控制器相结合。该框架将目标条件化运动与局部挖掘解耦：共享的任务条件化强化学习策略控制路径点引导的接近和满载运输，而模仿学习策略则从专家示范中学习基于视觉的挖掘和提升动作。挖掘目标从激光雷达高程图中选取，并转换为铲斗齿尖路径点以用于运动控制。控制架构通过共享运动接口协调学习策略与确定性卸载。完整系统部署在一台配备多模态感知和闭环执行器控制的缩比液压挖掘机上。离线回放和物理实验表明，与相应基线相比，该系统在目标选择一致性、局部运动时间缩短和有效载荷提升方面均表现更优。学习得到的挖掘策略平均每完成一个循环可获取6.52公斤有效载荷，而固定挖掘基线仅为2.68公斤。三次连续五铲试验进一步验证了在不断变化的料堆几何条件下系统的连续自主挖掘能力。

title: UCON: Uncertainty-aware Navigation with Historical Re-association in Dynamic Environments
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments is hindered by two fundamental challenges: perception instability and uncertainty-optimization mismatch. The former leads to identity switches and unreliable motion estimation, while the latter prevents principled incorporation of motion uncertainty into trajectory optimization. To address these challenges, we propose UCON, an uncertainty-aware navigation algorithm in dynamic environments. For perception instability, we present a point-level historical re-association mechanism that leverages historical point cloud fragments to recover lost targets while maintaining identity continuity. Subsequently, a Kalman filter is employed to provide anisotropic motion state estimation and covariance propagation. To resolve the uncertainty-optimization mismatch, we transform predicted states and their covariances into uncertainty sectors, which are embedded as differentiable cost terms within a trajectory optimization framework. This achieves consistent uncertainty-aware dynamic obstacle avoidance while maintaining smoothness and feasibility. Extensive simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate that, while maintaining high computational efficiency, UCON achieves superior perception stability and robust navigation performance in dynamic environments compared to state-of-the-art methods. The code will be open-sourced to facilitate further research.
tldr: UCON proposes an uncertainty-aware navigation algorithm for dynamic environments, combining a point-level historical re-association mechanism for stable perception with a Kalman-filter-based uncertainty propagation that is embedded into trajectory optimization as differentiable cost terms.
tldr_zh: UCON提出了一种用于动态环境的感知不确定性导航算法，结合点级历史重关联机制以稳定感知，并将卡尔曼滤波的协方差传播作为可微成本项嵌入轨迹优化中。
summary_zh: 动态环境中的自主导航面临两个基本挑战：感知不稳定性和不确定性-优化不匹配。前者导致身份切换和不可靠的运动估计，而后者阻碍了将运动不确定性以原则性方式纳入轨迹优化中。为解决这些挑战，我们提出了UCON，一种动态环境中不确定性感知的导航算法。针对感知不稳定性，我们提出了一种点级历史重关联机制，利用历史点云片段恢复丢失目标，同时保持身份连续性。随后，采用卡尔曼滤波器提供各向异性的运动状态估计和协方差传播。为解决不确定性-优化不匹配问题，我们将预测状态及其协方差转换为不确定性扇区，并将其作为可微分的成本项嵌入轨迹优化框架中。这在不牺牲平滑性和可行性的前提下，实现了一致的不确定性感知动态障碍物规避。大量仿真和真实世界实验表明，在保持高计算效率的同时，UCON在动态环境中相较于现有最先进方法实现了更优的感知稳定性和鲁棒导航性能。相关代码将开源以促进进一步研究。

title: A Simple Gripper Interface for Simulator-Agnostic Cloth Manipulation
summary: This paper presents a grasping model for cloth manipulation specifically tailored to ease the deployment of robotic control methods. The model is robust, fast and easy to implement avoiding at the same time contact and friction considerations between the gripper and the cloth in favor of simple positional constraints. The gripper is described by its pose, jaw state, and an attached grasping volume. Two kinds of grasping volumes are considered: an axis-aligned box to simulate a pinch grasping and a square pyramidal volume to simulate point grasping. When the gripper closes, the discrete cloth positions lying inside this volume are selected, stored in the local gripper frame, and then transported with the gripper motion. A simple squeezing step is also included to progressively move the selected cloth positions toward the center of the grasping region, avoiding an instantaneous displacement at closure. The model can be used in any simulator as it only requires access to discrete cloth positions and a mechanism for imposing target positions as constraints. We implement our grasping model in conjunction with a constraint-based inextensible cloth simulator, where grasping is implemented as moving positional equality constraints coupled with stretch, shear, collision, and table contact projection steps. The same gripper trajectory is applied on a robot arm to fold a real piece of cloth, serving as a simple bridge between simulation and physical cloth manipulation and showcasing the realism and practicality of our idealized grasping model.
tldr: This paper proposes a simple, simulator-agnostic grasping model for cloth manipulation based on positional constraints and grasping volumes, and demonstrates its practicality by transferring a trajectory from simulation to a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种简单且与模拟器无关的布料抓取模型，基于位置约束和抓取体积，并通过将仿真轨迹迁移到真实机器人展示其实用性。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向布料操作的抓取模型，旨在简化机器人控制方法的部署。该模型鲁棒、快速且易于实现，同时避免了夹爪与布料之间的接触和摩擦考虑，转而采用简单的位置约束。夹爪由其位姿、钳口状态及附着的抓取体积描述。本文考虑了两种抓取体积：用于模拟捏取抓取的轴向对齐盒体，以及用于模拟点抓取的方锥体积。当夹爪闭合时，位于该体积内的离散布料位置被选中，存储于夹爪局部坐标系中，并随夹爪运动而移动。模型还包含一个简单的挤压步骤，以逐步将被选中的布料位置移向抓取区域中心，避免闭合时产生瞬时位移。该模型无需复杂的接触模拟，仅需访问离散布料位置及施加目标位置约束的机制，因此可适用于任何仿真器。我们将该抓取模型与基于约束的不可拉伸布料仿真器结合实现，其中抓取通过移动位置等式约束实现，并与拉伸、剪切、碰撞及桌面接触投影步骤耦合。相同的夹爪轨迹被应用于真实机器人手臂以折叠一块实际布料，从而在仿真与物理布料操作之间架起简单桥梁，展示了所提出的理想化抓取模型的真实性与实用性。

title: EgoSpeedUp: Transferring Human Manipulation Tempo to Robot Policies
summary: Robot manipulation policies trained through imitation learning inherit not only the demonstrated behavior but also the conservative execution tempo of robot demonstrations. Existing acceleration approaches can execute faster than the original demonstrations, but determine the appropriate acceleration primarily from robot-side information or a predefined set of tempo factors, leaving open how to obtain a task-appropriate reference for how fast each manipulation phase should progress. We introduce EgoSpeedUp, a framework that uses human manipulation as temporal supervision for robot imitation learning. Our key insight is that human demonstrations naturally reveal task-appropriate, phase-wise manipulation tempo. Given slow robot demonstrations and human demonstrations of the same task, EgoSpeedUp aligns corresponding manipulation phases, estimates their relative execution tempos from multiple human demonstrations, and transfers the resulting phase-wise tempo by retiming the robot demonstrations. The retimed demonstrations are then used for standard behavior cloning, allowing the robot to retain its executable manipulation behavior while learning to perform it at a human-informed tempo. Across two real-world manipulation tasks, EgoSpeedUp improves the task success rate by an average of 25 percentage points (pp) while reducing successful execution time by 36.5%. These results demonstrate that human manipulation tempo provides an effective temporal reference for learning faster and more reliable robot policies.
tldr: EgoSpeedUp uses human demonstrations to infer phase-wise manipulation tempo and retimes slow robot demonstrations, improving success rate and speed in real-world imitation learning.
tldr_zh: EgoSpeedUp 利用人类演示推断阶段性的操作节奏，并据此重新定时缓慢的机器人演示，从而在真实世界模仿学习中提高成功率和速度。
summary_zh: 通过模仿学习训练的机器人操作策略，不仅继承了示范行为，还继承了机器人示范中保守的执行节奏。现有的加速方法能够比原始示范执行得更快，但主要依据机器人侧信息或预定义的节奏因子来确定适当的加速程度，这仍然留下了如何获取任务适宜的、每个操作阶段应推进速度的参考标准的问题。我们引入了EgoSpeedUp框架，该框架利用人类操作作为机器人模仿学习的时间监督信号。我们的关键洞见在于，人类示范自然揭示了任务适宜的分阶段操作节奏。针对同一任务，给定慢速的机器人示范和人类示范，EgoSpeedUp对齐相应的操作阶段，从多个人类示范中估计各阶段的相对执行节奏，并通过重新定时机器人示范来转移所得到的阶段性节奏。随后，重新定时后的示范被用于标准的行为克隆，使机器人能够在保留其可执行操作行为的同时，学习以符合人类节奏的速度执行任务。在两个真实世界的操作任务中，EgoSpeedUp将任务成功率平均提高了25个百分点，同时将成功执行时间减少了36.5%。这些结果表明，人类操作节奏为学习更快、更可靠的机器人策略提供了有效的时间参考。

title: Continuous Online Fault Detection for Mobile Robots via Adaptive Edge Models
summary: Mobile robots require robust, real-time fault detection capable of continuous adaptation on constrained edge hardware. While deep time-series models excel at unsupervised anomaly detection, their computational cost prohibits high-frequency onboard execution. This paper bridges this gap via a Teacher-Student distillation framework. An offline foundation model (TSPulse) generates pseudo-labels from unlabeled time series augmented with fault injections. A lightweight MiniRocket Student, adapted with a Recursive Least Squares estimator, approximates this complex decision boundary to execute real-time inference onboard. Evaluations on the TSB-AD benchmark and a physical mobile robot demonstrate the Student achieves a 4.30 ms CPU inference latency. During real-world domain shifts, online adaptation enables the Student to recover from unseen mechanical degradation, improving VUS-PR scores from 0.26 to 0.75 without catastrophic forgetting. Crucially, an uncertainty-guided active learning strategy minimizes operator cognitive load, requesting sparse interventions only when encountering novel fault distributions. These results validate the deployment of state-of-the-art anomaly detection on resource-constrained robotics through offline-to-online distillation.
tldr: This paper presents a Teacher-Student distillation framework for continuous, real-time onboard fault detection in mobile robots, using an offline foundation model to train a lightweight student model with online adaptation and active learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于移动机器人连续实时故障检测的师生蒸馏框架，利用离线基础模型训练轻量级学生模型，并支持在线自适应和主动学习。
summary_zh: 移动机器人在受限的边缘硬件上运行，需要具备稳健、实时的故障检测能力，并能够持续自适应。尽管深度时间序列模型在无监督异常检测方面表现出色，但其计算成本过高，难以支持高频机载执行。本文通过教师-学生蒸馏框架弥补了这一不足。一个离线基础模型（TSPulse）利用注入故障的无标签时间序列生成伪标签，轻量化的MiniRocket学生模型则通过递归最小二乘估计器进行适配，以近似这一复杂决策边界，从而实现机载实时推理。在TSB-AD基准测试及实体移动机器人上的评估结果表明，该学生模型在CPU上实现了4.30毫秒的推理延迟。在真实世界域偏移场景下，在线自适应使学生模型能够从未见过的机械退化中恢复，并将VUS-PR评分从0.26提升至0.75，同时避免灾难性遗忘。尤为重要的是，一种基于不确定性引导的主动学习策略可最大限度地降低操作员的认知负担，仅在遇到新故障分布时才请求稀疏的人工干预。上述结果验证了通过离线到在线的蒸馏方法，可在资源受限的机器人平台上部署先进的异常检测技术。

title: Anthropomimetic Soft Robotic Forearm with Independently Articulated Carpal Bones Enabling Human-Like Adaptive Stiffness Modulability
summary: The human wrist exhibits adaptive stiffness modulability: joint stiffness anisotropy can be actively regulated through muscle co-contraction. This functionality is essential for stable manipulation, yet the underlying morphological factors remain unclear. To identify these factors, we developed an anatomically accurate anthropomimetic soft robotic forearm comprising eight independently movable carpal bones interconnected by ligaments, 22 actuated muscles, and compliant fingertips. We measured wrist joint stiffness under four muscle activation patterns across three skeletal configurations: anatomically normal carpal bones, a fused proximal carpal row, and a geometric ellipsoidal skeleton. The stiffness ellipse exhibited low stiffness along the dart-throwing motion (DTM) direction when finger muscles were activated, but high stiffness along the same direction when wrist and finger muscles were activated simultaneously. These results agree with previously reported human measurements, demonstrating that precise anatomical replication reproduces human-like stiffness modulability. Fusing the proximal carpal row eliminated the low DTM-direction stiffness under finger muscle activation, while the geometric ellipsoidal skeleton showed poor stiffness ellipse reorientation across all conditions. Carpal bone motion analysis revealed significantly opposing coupling patterns between wrist and finger muscles at the proximal carpal row, accompanied by a consistent but non-significant trend at the midcarpal joint, providing a mechanical explanation for this modulation. These findings demonstrate that carpal bone morphology plays a dominant role in human wrist stiffness modulation and provide design principles for humanoid robot wrists.
tldr: The paper presents an anthropomimetic soft robotic forearm with independently articulated carpal bones that replicates human wrist stiffness modulation, demonstrating that carpal bone morphology is crucial for adaptive stiffness and providing design principles for humanoid wrists.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一种具有独立腕骨的人形柔软机械前臂，能够复现人类腕部刚度调节，证明腕骨形态对自适应刚度至关重要，并为仿人手腕设计提供原则。
summary_zh: 人类腕部具有自适应刚度调节能力：关节刚度的各向异性可通过肌肉协同收缩进行主动调控。这一功能对稳定操作至关重要，但其潜在的形态学因素尚不明确。为识别这些因素，我们开发了一种解剖学精确的仿人软组织机器人前臂，该装置包含八块由韧带连接、可独立运动的腕骨，22块驱动肌肉以及柔性指尖。我们在四种肌肉激活模式下，针对三种骨骼构型测量了腕关节刚度：解剖学正常的腕骨、融合的近排腕骨以及几何椭球形骨骼。结果表明，当仅手指肌肉激活时，刚度椭圆沿投掷样运动（DTM）方向呈现低刚度；而当腕部与手指肌肉同时激活时，沿同一方向则呈现高刚度。这些结果与此前报道的人体测量数据一致，证明精确的解剖复制能够再现类人的刚度调节能力。融合近排腕骨后，手指肌肉激活状态下的DTM方向低刚度特性消失，而几何椭球形骨骼在所有条件下均表现出较差的刚度椭圆重定向能力。腕骨运动分析显示，腕部与手指肌肉在近排腕骨处呈现出显著相反的耦合模式，同时在腕中关节处存在一致但未达显著性的趋势，这为上述调节机制提供了力学解释。这些发现表明，腕骨形态在人类腕部刚度调节中起主导作用，并为仿人机器人腕部设计提供了原则性指导。

title: Representation World Model: Learning States, Transition and Executable Plans in Representation
summary: We propose the Representation World Model (RWM), which learns states, transitions, and executable plans directly in representation space. Unlike existing world models that typically learn latent representations together with explicit dynamics models and perform planning through search, optimization, or policy-based prediction, RWM directly incorporates planning into the learned representation geometry. RWM learns the representation geometry by applying inverse-dynamics supervision locally along latent paths constructed from endpoint representations, requiring these paths to preserve task-relevant state and transition information. At inference, planning is performed by directly constructing a latent path between the current and goal representations, with inverse dynamics used to recover the corresponding actions, without recursive rollouts or action-space search. Experiments on continuous-control benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of RWM for direct planning, while results on robotic manipulation further show its potential to extend to more complex embodied control tasks. These results suggest that planning directly in representation space provides a promising alternative to conventional world-model planning.
tldr: RWM is a world model that learns state representations and transitions directly in representation space, enabling planning by constructing latent paths between endpoint representations and recovering actions via inverse dynamics, without recursive rollouts. It is evaluated on continuous-control benchmarks and robotic manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: RWM 是一种在世界模型，直接在表示空间中学习状态和转移，通过构建端点表示之间的潜在路径并利用逆动力学恢复动作来进行规划，无需递归展开。在连续控制基准和机器人操作任务上进行了评估。
summary_zh: 我们提出了表示世界模型（RWM），该模型直接在表示空间中学习状态、转换和可执行计划。与现有世界模型通常将潜在表示与显式动力学模型一起学习，并通过搜索、优化或基于策略的预测进行规划不同，RWM直接将规划融入学习到的表示几何结构中。RWM通过在由端点表示构建的潜在路径上局部应用逆动力学监督来学习表示几何结构，要求这些路径保留与任务相关的状态和转换信息。在推理时，规划通过直接在当前表示与目标表示之间构建潜在路径来实现，并利用逆动力学恢复相应的动作，无需递归展开或动作空间搜索。在连续控制基准上的实验证明了RWM在直接规划中的有效性，而机器人操作任务的结果进一步展示了其在更复杂的具身控制任务中的扩展潜力。这些结果表明，直接在表示空间中进行规划为传统世界模型规划提供了一种有前景的替代方案。

title: OREN-X: Octree Residual Network for Real-Time Multi-Modal Mapping
summary: To achieve general-purpose autonomy over long horizons, a robot needs to maintain spatial environment information that supports a variety of tasks: geometry for planning and control, radiance for rendering and relocalization, and vision-language features for open-vocabulary grounding. Existing methods represent and estimate each modality separately, multiplying memory and compute cost while forgoing potential synergy among the representations. We develop OREN-X, an online mapping method that uses an octree in 3D space as a shared data structure for indexing and storing a multi-modal field, capturing geometric, radiance, and vision-language information. OREN-X provides efficient unified storage and retrieval of these data in explicit/implicit and full/compressed form. Our unified representation yields cross-modality synergy: SDF estimates are sharpened by occupancy and radiance, while GPU-based ray-octree traversal and octree query enable real-time rendering. We also use online dictionary learning to compress the vision-language features, shrinking them 3.7x below full per-vertex storage while raising the query accuracy. On Replica, OREN-X maps in real time (80+ fps for SDF and 30+ fps for all four modalities), improves near-surface SDF accuracy by 33% over single-modality baselines, and improves mean open-vocabulary 3D mIoU by 71% and mean accuracy by 61% over the best prior method.
tldr: OREN-X introduces an octree-based multi-modal mapping method that simultaneously stores geometric, radiance, and vision-language features for robots, achieving real-time performance and improved accuracy.
tldr_zh: OREN-X提出了一种基于八叉树的多模态建图方法，可同时存储几何、辐射度和视觉语言特征，为机器人实现实时建图并提高精度。
summary_zh: 为实现长时程的通用自主性，机器人需维护支持多种任务的空间环境信息：用于规划与控制的几何信息、用于渲染与重定位的辐射信息，以及用于开放词汇语义定位的视觉-语言特征。现有方法对各模态分别进行表示与估计，导致内存和计算成本成倍增加，且未能利用各表示之间的潜在协同效应。我们提出了OREN-X，一种在线建图方法，以三维空间中的八叉树作为共享数据结构，用于索引和存储多模态场，涵盖几何、辐射及视觉-语言信息。OREN-X以显式/隐式及完整/压缩形式实现这些数据的高效统一存储与检索。我们的统一表示带来了跨模态协同效应：SDF估计通过占据信息和辐射信息得到锐化，而基于GPU的射线-八叉树遍历和八叉树查询则实现了实时渲染。此外，我们采用在线字典学习对视觉-语言特征进行压缩，相比完全逐顶点存储，压缩幅度达3.7倍，同时查询精度得到提升。在Replica数据集上，OREN-X实现实时建图（SDF达80+帧每秒，四种模态达30+帧每秒），近表面SDF精度相比单模态基线提升33%，开放词汇三维mIoU均值较先前最优方法提升71%，平均精度提升61%。

title: A Tendon-Driven Robotic Jellyfish with Constrained Soft Actuation and Depth Control via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Jellyfish-inspired robots offer a compliant and efficient approach to underwater locomotion, but achieving large deformation together with repeatable actuation and closed-loop control remains challenging. In this work, we present a tendon-driven robotic jellyfish with constrained soft actuation. Each actuator combines a flexible substrate with discrete constraints, enabling bending up to \(150^\circ\) with an approximately linear tendon displacement-bending relationship. Eight actuators driven by four servos allow the robot to perform stable swimming, attitude adjustment, and self-righting. Based on the linear actuation, a reinforcement-learning controller is further developed, enabling closed-loop depth regulation in both simulation and physical experiments. These results show that mechanical constraints can improve the controllability of soft actuation while preserving compliant jellyfish-like motion, providing a route toward manoeuvrable and autonomous jellyfish robots.
tldr: This paper presents a tendon-driven robotic jellyfish with constrained soft actuators that achieve large, repeatable bending and uses reinforcement learning for closed-loop depth control in simulation and on the physical robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种肌腱驱动的软体机器水母，通过约束软体驱动实现大变形和可重复弯曲，并利用强化学习在仿真和实物中实现闭环深度控制。
summary_zh: 摘要：受水母启发的机器人为水下运动提供了一种柔顺且高效的方法，但实现大变形的同时兼顾可重复驱动和闭环控制仍然具有挑战性。本研究提出了一种采用受限软驱动方式的绳驱水母机器人。每个驱动器由柔性基底和离散约束组成，可实现高达150°的弯曲，且肌腱位移与弯曲角度之间近似呈线性关系。由四个舵机驱动的八个驱动器使机器人能够执行稳定游动、姿态调整和自扶正动作。基于该线性驱动特性，进一步开发了强化学习控制器，在仿真和物理实验中均实现了闭环深度调节。结果表明，机械约束能够在不损失水母柔顺运动特性的前提下提升软驱动的可控性，为研制高机动性、自主化的水母机器人提供了一条可行路径。

title: A Support-Enhanced Granular-Jamming Gripper for RL-based Grasping with Continuum Manipulators
summary: Continuum manipulators provide dexterous motion in confined spaces, but structural compliance, hysteresis, and load-dependent deformation leave residual position and orientation errors that can undermine reliable contact with rigid grippers. To address this limitation, this paper presents a lightweight support-enhanced granular-jamming gripper tailored to a continuum manipulator. The gripper maintains compliance before jamming while establishing a direct load path to the continuum manipulator tip after jamming. To improve its grasping performance, we systematically designed membrane materials, particles, filling ratios, and the internal support structure, and further identify geometry-dependent grasp boundaries with respect to contact offset and object shape. Building on these results, we construct a physical manipulation system integrating the continuum manipulator, granular-jamming gripper, visual feedback, tendon actuation, and pneumatic control. We then train a reinforcement-learning-based reaching controller in a randomized simulation and deploy it on the physical system, demonstrating how positioning control and contact level mechanical adaptation can complement each other in a modular grasp-and-release task. By introducing an adaptive structure that relaxes the need for highly accurate modeling and positioning control, this work explores a design paradigm that integrates physical and embodied intelligence.
tldr: This paper presents a support-enhanced granular-jamming gripper for continuum manipulators, designed to combine compliance with a direct load path after jamming, and demonstrates a modular grasp-and-release task using an RL-based reaching controller deployed on a physical system.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种适用于连续体机械臂的支撑增强型颗粒阻塞夹持器，在阻塞前保持柔顺性，阻塞后建立直接负载路径，并通过物理系统上的RL控制验证了模块化抓取与释放任务。
summary_zh: 连续体机械臂能够在受限空间中实现灵巧运动，但结构柔顺性、迟滞效应及负载相关变形会残留位置与姿态误差，从而削弱刚性夹爪可靠接触的能力。为解决该问题，本文提出了一种面向连续体机械臂的轻量化支撑增强型颗粒阻塞夹爪。该夹爪在阻塞前保持柔顺性，同时在阻塞后建立与连续体机械臂末端的直接载荷传递路径。为提升其抓取性能，我们系统设计了隔膜材料、颗粒、填充率及内部支撑结构，并进一步识别了与接触偏移量和物体形状相关的几何依赖抓取边界。基于上述结果，我们构建了一套物理操控系统，集成连续体机械臂、颗粒阻塞夹爪、视觉反馈、腱驱动及气动控制。随后，我们在随机化仿真中训练了一种基于强化学习的到达控制器，并将其部署于物理系统上，验证了定位控制与接触层面机械自适应在模块化抓取-释放任务中的互补作用。通过引入一种放宽高精度建模与定位控制需求的自适应结构，本研究探索了一种融合物理智能与具身智能的设计范式。

title: From Passive Execution to Active Exploration: Agentic Embodied Manipulation in Realistic Environments
summary: Recent advances in agentic systems have substantially enhanced the long-horizon capability of embodied manipulation. However, many existing frameworks still follow a passive execution paradigm, which limits their applicability to real-world scenarios involving textual semantic cues, distractors, and initially invisible targets. To bridge this gap, we propose an agent-based active exploration framework that enables robots to dynamically interact with the environment rather than merely execute predefined instructions. Specifically, our framework consists of three collaborative modules: a planning module for high-level task reasoning, a perception module for visual scene understanding, and an execution module for low-level manipulation. This design allows the robot to actively acquire task-relevant information, adapt its behavior based on environmental feedback, and complete manipulation tasks under partial observability. Furthermore, we introduce a fine-grained perception-execution interleaving strategy, which tightly couples visual feedback with skill execution to improve exploration robustness. We evaluate our method on a realistic Find-and-Place task, demonstrating its effectiveness in challenging environments where target objects must be actively discovered before manipulation.
tldr: This paper proposes an agentic active exploration framework for embodied manipulation that integrates planning, perception, and execution modules with a fine-grained perception-execution interleaving strategy to handle partial observability and distractors, validated on a realistic Find-and-Place task.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于具身操作的智能体主动探索框架，集成了规划、感知和执行模块，并通过细粒度的感知-执行交错策略来处理部分可观测性和干扰物，在真实感的寻找与放置任务中验证了其有效性。
summary_zh: 智能体系统的最新进展显著增强了具身操作的长时程能力。然而，许多现有框架仍遵循被动执行范式，这限制了其在涉及文本语义线索、干扰物及初始不可见目标的真实场景中的适用性。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了一种基于智能体的主动探索框架，使机器人能够动态地与环境交互，而不仅仅执行预定义指令。具体而言，我们的框架由三个协同模块组成：用于高层任务推理的规划模块、用于视觉场景理解的感知模块，以及用于低层操作的执行模块。该设计使机器人能够主动获取任务相关信息，根据环境反馈调整自身行为，并在部分可观测条件下完成操作任务。此外，我们引入了一种细粒度的感知-执行交错策略，将视觉反馈与技能执行紧密结合，以提升探索的鲁棒性。我们在一个真实的“查找-放置”任务上评估了所提方法，验证了其在目标物体需在操作前被主动发现的挑战性环境中的有效性。

title: DA-GRD: Decision-Aware Grasp-Relevant Disambiguation for tactile recovery under perception-to-execution mismatches
summary: Grasping is a fundamental robotic capability that bridges perception and physical task execution. This paper studies grasp pose recovery under a perception-to-execution mismatch, where a grasp generated from visual perception may become spatially stale if the object moves before execution, using only sparse tactile interactions and no further visual observations. We propose DA-GRD, Decision-Aware Grasp-Relevant Disambiguation, which maintains a weighted planar belief over possible object configurations and selects tactile probes according to their ability to eliminate hypotheses and improve agreement among candidate task grasps. Rather than fully relocalizing the object, DA-GRD stops when the remaining hypotheses support a common executable grasp. In MuJoCo experiments on ten rigid objects with translations up to 5~cm and yaw perturbations up to $\pm45^\circ$, DA-GRD achieves an 84.7% physical lift success rate, compared with 9.1% for stale AnyGrasp, 21.2% for the original fix-scan baseline, and 63.7% for fix-scan method adapted with an SE(2) belief. DA-GRD also achieves a 57.3% Task conditioned Success rate. Across objects, it uses a success-average of 4.13 tactile probes over the ten per-object means, corresponding to a 72.5% reduction relative to the fixed 15-probe baselines. Real-world experiments on six objects achieve 71.7% physical lift success and 38.3% task-conditioned success with 4.20 probes on average. These results show that tactile sensing can recover task-relevant grasps under vision-off conditions with limited physical interaction, without requiring complete object localization.
tldr: DA-GRD proposes a decision-aware tactile probing strategy that recovers task-relevant grasps under perception-to-execution mismatches using sparse tactile interactions, significantly improving physical lift success over stale-visual baselines in both simulation and real-world experiments.
tldr_zh: DA-GRD 提出了一种决策感知的触觉探测策略，在感知-执行不匹配情况下利用稀疏触觉交互恢复任务相关抓取，在仿真和真实实验中显著优于基于过时视觉的基线。
summary_zh: 抓取是一项基础的机器人能力，它将感知与物理任务执行连接起来。本文研究了在感知-执行不匹配条件下的抓取姿态恢复问题，即当物体在执行前发生移动时，仅依靠稀疏的触觉交互且无进一步视觉观测的情况下，从视觉感知生成的抓取可能变得空间上过时。我们提出DA-GRD（决策感知的抓取相关消歧方法），该方法维护关于可能物体配置的加权平面信念，并根据触觉探测消除假设及提升候选任务抓取间一致性的能力来选择触觉探测点。DA-GRD并不完全重新定位物体，而是在剩余假设支持一个共同的可执行抓取时停止。在以多达5厘米平移和±45°偏航扰动为条件的十个刚性物体的MuJoCo实验中，DA-GRD实现了84.7%的物理提升成功率，而过时的AnyGrasp为9.1%，原始固定扫描基线为21.2%，采用SE(2)信念调整后的固定扫描方法为63.7%。DA-GRD还实现了57.3%的任务条件成功率。在各物体上，它平均使用4.13次触觉探测（基于十个物体各自均值的成功平均值），相对于固定的15次探测基线减少了72.5%。在六个物体上的真实世界实验中，实现了71.7%的物理提升成功率和38.3%的任务条件成功率，平均使用4.20次探测。这些结果表明，在无视觉条件下，触觉感知能够以有限的物理交互恢复任务相关的抓取，而无需完整的物体定位。

title: Design and Evaluation of LLM Chaining-Based Task Planning for General Purpose Service Robots
summary: General Purpose Service Robot (GPSR) tasks, as defined in the RoboCup@Home benchmark, require robots to interpret diverse natural language commands and generate multi-step action sequences in real home environments. Conventional Single Prompt (SP) approaches suffer from context bloat and the "Lost in the Middle" phenomenon, leading to unreliable task planning. We propose an LLM chaining architecture that separates instruction classification and action generation into two specialized stages, reducing per-inference prompt length by approximately 45% while improving planning consistency. We evaluate our method using 100 randomly generated GPSR commands across three language models spanning local open-source and frontier cloud deployment contexts. Results show consistent planning improvements over SP across all models, with gains of up to +37 percentage points on local models. Further, real-robot execution experiments on the Toyota Human Support Robot (HSR) reveal that planning success alone does not guarantee task completion, with 6 of 10 tasks completing successfully and execution-layer failures identified as the primary remaining bottleneck.
tldr: This paper proposes an LLM chaining architecture for task planning in general purpose service robots, reducing prompt length and improving planning consistency across three language models, with real-robot execution showing planning success does not guarantee task completion.
tldr_zh: 本文针对通用服务机器人任务规划，提出了一种LLM链式架构，减少了约45%的提示长度并提高了规划一致性，在三个语言模型上验证了效果，真实机器人实验表明规划成功并不保证任务完成。
summary_zh: 通用服务机器人（GPSR）任务，如RoboCup@Home基准测试中所定义的，要求机器人在真实家庭环境中解读多样化的自然语言指令并生成多步骤动作序列。传统的单一提示（SP）方法面临上下文膨胀及“中间迷失”现象，导致任务规划可靠性不足。我们提出了一种大语言模型（LLM）链式架构，将指令分类与动作生成分离为两个专门阶段，在减少每次推理提示长度约45%的同时提升了规划的一致性。我们使用100条随机生成的GPSR指令，对涵盖本地开源及前沿云端部署场景的三个语言模型进行了评估。结果表明，与SP方法相比，所有模型在规划性能上均获得一致提升，其中本地模型的提升幅度最高达+37个百分点。此外，在丰田人类支持机器人（HSR）上进行的真机执行实验显示，规划成功并不能保证任务完成，10项任务中有6项顺利完成，执行层故障被识别为当前最主要的剩余瓶颈。

title: Simple Torque-Observation Alignment for Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Grasping with a Direct-Drive Gripper
summary: Torque observations in reinforcement learning remain challenging because simulated and measured torque differ in scale, offset, and noise. In this paper, we propose a simple torque observation alignment method for robots with direct-drive (DD) actuators, in which motor current maps linearly to joint torque through a motor-type-specific torque constant K_tau. First, dynamometer calibration identifies K_tau* and corrects the scale mismatch between simulated and real torque. Second, the method uses delta_tau(t) = tau(t) - tau(t-1) as the observation in both domains to eliminate the constant offset instead of using the direct torque tau(t), which carries a domain-dependent bias. Third, Gaussian noise obtained from the dynamometer measurement data is injected during the learning process. To validate the proposed method, we train a teacher-student grasping policy entirely in simulation and deploy the distilled student on a multifingered DD gripper. The deployed policy performs proprioceptive grasping using only joint positions and torque differences. We conduct an ablation study comparing the proposed method with alternative alignment variants on nine in-distribution (ID) objects. The proposed method achieves 100% grasp success. These results demonstrate that the proposed alignment method improves the robustness of zero-shot policy transfer on the DD gripper against real-world torque-observation mismatches.
tldr: This paper presents a simple torque observation alignment method for zero-shot sim-to-real transfer of a grasping policy on a direct-drive gripper, using dynamometer calibration, delta torque observations, and injected Gaussian noise, achieving 100% grasp success in ablation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种简单的扭矩观测对齐方法，用于直驱夹爪上抓取策略的零样本仿真到现实迁移，通过测功机标定、增量扭矩观测和注入高斯噪声，在消融实验中实现了100%的抓取成功率。
summary_zh: 扭矩观测在强化学习中仍然具有挑战性，因为模拟扭矩与实测扭矩在尺度、偏移和噪声方面存在差异。本文提出了一种适用于直驱（DD）执行器机器人的简洁扭矩观测对齐方法，其中电机电流通过电机类型特定的扭矩常数 K_tau 线性映射至关节扭矩。首先，测功机标定确定 K_tau*，并修正模拟扭矩与真实扭矩之间的尺度失配。其次，该方法在两个域中均使用 delta_tau(t) = tau(t) - tau(t-1) 作为观测值，以消除恒定偏移，而非使用携带域相关偏差的直接扭矩 tau(t)。第三，在学习过程中注入从测功机测量数据中获取的高斯噪声。为验证所提方法，我们完全在仿真环境中训练一个教师-学生抓取策略，并将蒸馏后的学生模型部署于多指直驱夹爪上。部署后的策略仅利用关节位置和扭矩差值实现本体感觉抓取。我们进行了消融研究，在九个分布内（ID）物体上比较了所提方法与替代对齐变体的性能。所提方法实现了100%的抓取成功率。这些结果表明，所提出的对齐方法增强了直驱夹爪上零样本策略迁移对真实世界扭矩观测失配的鲁棒性。

title: Outcome-Sensitive Motion Search for Impact-Aware Dexterous Catching
summary: Skilled humans can catch fast-moving objects softly by coordinating interception, velocity matching, and follow-through to mitigate impact. Learning such impact-aware catching with reinforcement learning (RL), however, is challenging, as the policy must achieve reliable interception and grasping while regulating the sensitive transition into contact. Moreover, even a capable privileged-state RL teacher may not provide ideal demonstrations for a deployable imitation-learning (IL) student: teacher failures limit task coverage, while small variations in pre-contact motion can produce substantially different impact and grasping outcomes. We characterize this phenomenon through interventional outcome sensitivity and introduce the outcome-sensitive window (OSW) to guide targeted demonstration construction. Building on this formulation, we propose Outcome-Sensitive Motion Search, which learns a task-conditioned manifold of successful OSW motions and performs local geodesic search to refine successful teacher rollouts and repair task conditions where the teacher fails. We then validate candidate motions through complete rollouts under a calibrated IL-student action-error model and retain only successful executions as demonstrations. Extensive simulation experiments demonstrate that our method effectively repairs task conditions where the teacher fails and enables the resulting IL policy to outperform the privileged RL teacher in both catching success and impact mitigation.
tldr: This paper introduces Outcome-Sensitive Motion Search, a method that refines successful teacher rollouts and repairs failing conditions to generate better demonstrations for imitation learning in impact-aware dexterous catching, enabling the learned policy to outperform the privileged RL teacher.
tldr_zh: 本文提出结果敏感运动搜索方法，通过细化成功的教师轨迹并修复失败条件，为冲击感知灵巧接物生成更优的模仿学习演示，使学到的策略在接取成功率和冲击缓解上超越特权强化学习教师。
summary_zh: 熟练的人类能够通过协调拦截、速度匹配和随球动作来柔和地接住快速移动的物体，从而减轻冲击。然而，使用强化学习（RL）来学习这种具有冲击感知能力的接物动作颇具挑战性，因为策略必须在调节接触时敏感过渡的同时，实现可靠的拦截与抓取。此外，即使是一个能力强大的特权状态强化学习教师模型，也可能无法为可部署的模仿学习（IL）学生模型提供理想的示范：教师模型的失败会限制任务覆盖范围，而接触前动作的微小变化可能导致截然不同的冲击与抓取结果。我们通过干预性结果敏感性来刻画这一现象，并引入结果敏感窗口（OSW）以指导有针对性的示范构建。在此基础上，我们提出了结果敏感性动作搜索方法，该方法学习一个以任务为条件的成功OSW动作流形，并执行局部测地线搜索来优化成功的教师模型轨迹，同时修复教师模型失败的任务条件。随后，我们在经过校准的IL学生模型动作误差模型下，通过完整轨迹验证候选动作，并仅保留成功执行的动作作为示范。大量仿真实验表明，我们的方法能够有效修复教师模型失败的任务条件，并使所得的IL策略在接球成功率和冲击减轻两方面均优于特权状态RL教师模型。

title: CALM: Current Aligned Link Manipulation for Single Arm Oversized Object Lifting
summary: Most robots manipulate objects solely with their end effectors, whereas humans flexibly leverage different body parts, such as the forearm and elbow, especially when handling oversized objects. Learning such whole-arm manipulation is chal-lenging due to long-horizon sparse rewards, limited contact sens-ing, and the sim-to-real gap in contact and actuator dynamics. To address these challenges, we propose Current-Aligned Link Manipulation, a framework for learning long-horizon contact-rich manipulation using motor current as joint load related feedback. Three stage-specific policies first learn repositioning, grasping, and lifting using privileged simulation information, and a stage router sequences them to generate complete task demonstrations. For sim-to-real transfer, a causal current mapper predicts physical motor current from simulated joint histories, aligning the actuator current observation between simulation and hardware. A unified student policy then learns from these demonstrations using only deployable sensor observations and is further refined with DAgger. The task policies are trained entirely in simulation, and the final student is deployed on hardware. Experiments demonstrate 76.2% (762/1000 trials) complete-task success in simulation and 73.3% success (22/30 trials) on the physical robot for sequential oversized-object lifting.
tldr: CALM introduces a framework for learning whole-arm manipulation of oversized objects by decomposing the task into stage-specific policies trained in simulation with motor current as feedback, and transfers to a real robot via a causal current mapper and DAgger, achieving high success rates in both simulation and hardware.
tldr_zh: CALM 提出了一种利用电机电流作为反馈、在仿真中训练分阶段策略并在真实机器人上通过因果电流映射和 DAgger 迁移的全身操纵框架，用于提升超大物体的顺序抓取与举升成功率。
summary_zh: 绝大多数机器人在操控物体时仅依赖其末端执行器，而人类则能灵活运用前臂、肘部等不同身体部位，尤其在处理超大物体时更为明显。学习这类全身臂部操控面临诸多挑战，包括长期稀疏奖励、有限的接触感知，以及接触与执行器动力学中的仿真到现实差距。为解决这些问题，我们提出了一种名为“电流对齐连杆操控”的框架，利用电机电流作为关节负载相关的反馈，来学习长时间跨度的接触丰富型操控任务。三个阶段特定的策略首先利用仿真中的特权信息分别学习重新定位、抓取和提升动作，并通过一个阶段路由器进行排序，生成完整的任务演示。为实现仿真到现实的迁移，我们设计了一个因果电流映射器，从模拟关节历史中预测物理电机电流，使执行器电流观测在仿真与硬件之间保持一致。随后，一个统一的学生策略仅使用可部署的传感器观测从这些演示中学习，并通过DAgger进一步优化。任务策略完全在仿真中训练，最终的学生策略部署于实体硬件。实验结果显示，在仿真中完整任务成功率达到76.2%（762/1000次试验），在实体机器人上顺序提起超大物体的成功率为73.3%（22/30次试验）。

title: ReVNM: Learning-Based Visual Navigation from a Remote Camera
summary: Visual Navigation Models (VNMs) enable robots to navigate from egocentric visual observations without geometric localization and planning, but long-range navigation still requires pre-built maps. This paper presents the Remote Visual Navigation Model (ReVNM), which uses a single remote surveillance camera to serve as both an observation source and an implicit environmental map for visual navigation. While the use of remote cameras could eliminate the need for pre-built maps as well as onboard vision processing, their limited field of view instead of egocentric observations makes it hard to achieve collision-free navigation. The lack of existing data with diverse remote viewpoints, which are crucial for training robust VNMs, further complicates the challenge. In this work, we propose a learning-by-synthesis approach to address this two-fold challenge. Our ReVNM extends a state-of-the-art VNM architecture with an exocentric-to-egocentric (exo2ego) module that predicts an egocentric depth observation from remote-camera observations. This helps the VNM to plan a path while considering obstacles in front of the robot. Trained only on randomly generated worlds with diverse obstacle layouts and camera viewpoints, ReVNM can generalize well to real robot navigation without additional fine-tuning. Experiments in both simulation and real-world environments confirmed the effectiveness of the proposed approach.
tldr: ReVNM introduces a learning-by-synthesis approach that enables a remote surveillance camera to act as an implicit map for visual navigation by predicting egocentric depth from exocentric observations, achieving collision-free robot navigation without pre-built maps or onboard vision processing.
tldr_zh: ReVNM 提出一种基于合成学习的方案，利用远程监控摄像头作为隐式地图，通过预测自我中心深度来实现无预先建图和无机载视觉处理的机器人导航。
summary_zh: 视觉导航模型（VNMs）使机器人能够仅凭自我中心的视觉观察进行导航，而无需几何定位与规划，但长距离导航仍依赖于预先构建的地图。本文提出了远程视觉导航模型（ReVNM），该模型利用单一远程监控摄像头，既作为观察来源，又作为视觉导航的隐式环境地图。尽管使用远程摄像头可省去预先构建地图及机载视觉处理的需求，但其有限的视野视角（而非自我中心的观察）使得实现无碰撞导航颇为困难。此外，现有数据中缺乏多样化的远程视角——而这对于训练鲁棒的VNMs至关重要——进一步加剧了这一挑战。在本研究中，我们提出了一种通过合成进行学习的方法，以应对这双重挑战。我们的ReVNM在先进VNM架构基础上，扩展了一个从外部视角到自我中心视角（exo2ego）的模块，该模块能从远程摄像头观察中预测自我中心的深度观察，从而帮助VNM在规划路径时考虑机器人前方的障碍物。仅利用随机生成的世界（包含多样化的障碍布局和摄像头视角）进行训练，ReVNM便能很好地泛化到真实机器人导航中，无需额外微调。在仿真及真实环境中的实验均证实了所提方法的有效性。

title: Sim-to-Real Aware End-to-End Learning Environment for Micromobility
summary: While end-to-end autonomous driving systems show promise, their application to micromobility vehicles is hindered by simulators failing to capture specific kinematics, such as differential drives and omni-wheels. This paper pro- poses a sim-to-real-aware, vehicle-specific end-to-end learning environment for the WHILL Model CR on AWSIM and ROS 2. To minimize the sim-to-real gap, physical parameters are optimized via Bayesian optimization using real-world data, reducing trajectory errors across various driving scenarios. Additionally, this study introduces a synchronized architecture tailored for the stable training of world model-based agents. An end-to-end policy trained with DreamerV3 exhibited learning progress and achieved task completion in a simulated obstacle avoidance setting. Furthermore, this policy demonstrated direct sim-to-real transfer to the physical vehicle, enabling the vehicle to navigate around a cardboard box in a real-world corridor replica without fine-tuning. This paper provides a practical foundation for sim-to-real micromobility policy studies.
tldr: This paper presents a sim-to-real aware, vehicle-specific end-to-end learning environment for the WHILL Model CR, using AWSIM and ROS 2 with Bayesian optimization to reduce the sim-to-real gap. A world model-based agent trained with DreamerV3 achieves task completion in simulation and direct sim-to-real transfer to a physical vehicle for obstacle avoidance.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个针对WHILL Model CR的仿真到现实感知的端到端学习环境，利用AWSIM和ROS 2通过贝叶斯优化减小仿真与现实差距。基于世界模型的DreamerV3智能体在仿真中实现任务完成，并直接迁移到实体车辆进行避障。
summary_zh: 尽管端到端自动驾驶系统展现出巨大潜力，但其在微型交通工具上的应用受到模拟器无法捕捉特定运动学的制约，例如差速驱动和全向轮。本文提出了一种面向WHILL Model CR的、具备仿真到现实感知能力的、车辆专属的端到端学习环境，该环境基于AWSIM和ROS 2构建。为最小化仿真与现实之间的差距，利用真实世界数据通过贝叶斯优化对物理参数进行优化，从而在多种驾驶场景下减少轨迹误差。此外，本研究引入了一种针对基于世界模型的智能体进行稳定训练的同步架构。使用DreamerV3训练的端到端策略在学习过程中表现出进步，并在模拟避障场景中成功完成任务。更进一步，该策略展示了直接从仿真迁移至实车的能力，使车辆能够在真实走廊复刻环境中绕过纸箱而无需微调。本文为微型交通工具的仿真到现实策略研究提供了实用的基础。

title: Koopman-Accelerated Model-Based Diffusion for Real-Time Robot Control
summary: Conventional model-based diffusion (MBD) achieves effective trajectory optimization by leveraging noise annealing. However, its high computational cost, primarily arising from repeated rollouts of the plant dynamics, has largely confined its use to offline settings. To address this limitation, this paper proposes bilinear Koopman model-based diffusion (BK-MBD). The proposed method lifts the robot's state into a high-dimensional space only once per control step and propagates all candidates in the lifted space thereafter, so each rollout reduces to a fixed number of matrix-vector multiplications. The lifted dynamics are bilinear, allowing the predicted input gain to vary with the robot's configuration, which a linear lifted model cannot represent. In simulation, BK-MBD completed each planning update in at most 14.7 ms within a 50 ms control period and reached the goal on every trial, whereas a linear lift almost never did. The annealed schedule improves closed-loop accuracy over fixed-noise schedules under the learned rollout. Under the exact rollout, both the annealed and fixed-narrow schedules reach every goal, indicating that annealing reduces sensitivity to surrogate-model error.
